privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This explains what Dentiq stores about you and why. It is a working draft written for the current version of the app.
collect: Your name and email address, used to create your account and send verification messages.
A password hash. Your password itself is never stored.
Your role and approval status, so moderators can control access.
Session details (IP address and browser) used to keep you signed in and protect your account.
Files and notes you upload, with their title, course, version and source information.
Your language and theme choice, kept in your browser.
use: To run your account and show you course material you are allowed to see.
To let moderators review uploads before they are shared.
We do not sell your data and we do not show advertising.
privacy.private: Material you mark as personal stays visible only to you. Shared material is visible to approved users. Access is checked on the server, not only in the interface.
privacy.rights: You can ask to see, correct or delete your account data. Contact details for these requests will be added before the public launch.
privacy.review: This draft has not been reviewed by a legal professional. It does not claim compliance with Quebec Law 25 or any other law.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These are the working rules for using Dentiq. They are a draft and will be reviewed before the public launch.

sections.title: Who can use Dentiq
sections.body: Dentiq is for dental students. Your account may need approval before you can see shared material.

sections.title: Your uploads
sections.body: Only upload material you have the right to share. Having a file does not give you permission to redistribute it. This applies especially to past exams and course documents from professors.

sections.title: Student content and official content
sections.body: Notes and resources written by students are not official course material. Always check them against your professors' sources.

sections.title: Moderation
sections.body: Moderators may hold back, correct or remove content that breaks these rules or that you are not allowed to share.

sections.title: Study use only
sections.body: Dentiq is a study aid. It does not provide clinical or professional advice.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: These terms may change before and after launch. We will update the date at the top of this page.
